style: 3D rendering with cinematic lighting; soft boundaries from lighting, no hard outlines; physically realistic gradients with soft highlights; warm, saturated greens and bronzes with golden highlights; metallic patina on robot, mossy wood, blurred foliage
content: A robot with glowing eyes and copper-green patina holds a watering can. It stands in a greenhouse with wooden planters and lush greenery.
